checks.name: Prominent Preview buttons visible for recommended and catalogue match rows
checks.details: recommended-preview-btn-0-0 and catalogue-preview-btn-0-1 were visible, labelled Preview, had an SVG eye icon, rounded-full pill classes, and no visible View source page link.

checks.name: Preview uses existing fields without backend calls
checks.details: swatch_crop_b64 match rendered catalogue-preview-image; color_hex-only match rendered catalogue-preview-hex with rgb(241, 235, 224). No /api/catalogue-preview or /api/admin/studio/uploads/... requests fired on preview click.

checks.name: Regular non-admin user can open preview without permission error
checks.details: Test user role=user opened preview lightbox; no permission error surfaced.

checks.name: Close controls
checks.details: Close button and ESC closed the lightbox, but backdrop click failed. The overlay bounding box after opening was x=868.328,y=570.594,width=344.328,height=1034.297 instead of the full 1920x1080 viewport, so a click at (20,20) was outside the overlay and did not close it.

root_cause_observed: MatchPreviewButton renders the fixed lightbox inside MaterialCard. When the card is focused/hovered it has transform classes (scale/translate), which creates a containing block for position: fixed descendants. The lightbox is therefore constrained to the transformed card/column instead of the viewport, unlike the shortlist swatch lightbox pattern.
